name: How long does a typical seismic upgrade project take to complete?
description: Project duration for a seismic upgrade varies from weeks to months, depending on scope, building size, and permitting timelines.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical seismic upgrade project take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a seismic upgrade project varies significantly based on the scope, building size, and permitting requirements. A smaller residential retrofit might take a few weeks, while a complex commercial project could extend for several months. The permitting phase can also impact the timeline, as it depends on the local city's review process, such as those in Alameda or Dublin.
